cvProfile: Digitalisation and systems architecture specialist with 18+ years delivering e-governance and digital public infrastructure (DPI) programmes in Bangladesh for UNDP, USAID and the British Council. T-shaped DPI governance specialist: DPI governance as the core discipline, applied to civil registration and vital statistics (CRVS), trade and business registries, NGO/CSO digitalisation and disaster management information systems. Founder of Synapse Consulting. Available for international remote consulting with UN agencies, international NGOs and donor-funded programmes.

featuredWork.heading: Digitalising NGO regulation in Bangladesh
featuredWork.intro: Embedded with the government agency that regulates every NGO and foreign-funded project in the country.
featuredWork.summary: Technical implementation of the NGOAB Online Solution, the national platform for NGO registration, project approval and oversight under the Institutional Strengthening for Promoting Accelerated Transformation (ISPAT) Project. Role-based dashboards serve NGOAB officials up to the Director General, district and upazila administrations (DCs and UNOs), and NGOs themselves, each scoped to its role and jurisdiction.
